final: WITH account_avgs AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), ratios AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, avg_amount, avg_amount / AVG(avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio FROM account_avgs) SELECT account_id, frequency, avg_amount, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
